criteria.status: mostly verified; footprint source is OSM rather than Purdue GIS
evidence: The saved official Our Saviour/PLM page titles the location Purdue Lutheran Ministry and lists 330 W Fowler Ave; the archived Purdue Resource Guide is included as an independent address reference.
OSM way/860901812 is explicitly tagged `name=Purdue Lutheran Ministry` and `building=church`; the raw closed 4-node geometry was reopened independently.

The Purdue BuildingShapes spatial query at the named site returned zero features, so the OSM footprint is not independently corroborated by Purdue GIS. The four structural wall objects track the transformed OSM ring to a 0.12 m nearest-vertex discrepancy, consistent with the shell wall depth, and the location pin falls inside the polygon.
criteria.reason: The building identity is well supported by official address/name evidence and the footprint is a direct named OSM record, but the lack of an authoritative Purdue GIS footprint warrants a small deduction.

criteria.status: verified in local frame; master marker pending
evidence: Fresh-open root has local position [0.0, 0.0, 0.0] and recorded campus anchor [345.768593, 45.9428] m.
Independently recomputed the OSM polygon centroid with the stated project transform: (345.768593, 45.942800) m, matching the root anchor within 0.000001 m.

The southern OSM ring edge is the Fowler-facing frontage; the model places the entry/sign/window facade on that south edge. Local bounds and OSM wall dimensions agree, with porch and eave projections extending beyond the footprint.
criteria.reason: Local origin, centroid, orientation and shell scale are consistent with the documented coordinate convention. No master placement marker was available to verify yet.

criteria.criterion: Evidence-backed height, floors, and roof form
evidence: The archived PLM facade image visibly shows two storeys and a shallow shingle porch canopy, supporting a two-storey shell and the front canopy.

The image crop does not show the main roof or full building height; the World Imagery tile only gives a low-resolution roof tone/footprint cue. Eaves at 5.70 m and ridge at 7.25 m are explicitly estimates, not measurements.
The north-south main gable pitch and overall roof silhouette are not verifiable from the provided elevations.
criteria.reason: The story count is suggested by the two rows of windows, but the eave/ridge heights and primary roof are inferred without measured elevation evidence.

criteria.status: south facade strongly source-backed; other faces interpreted
evidence: The PLM-hosted archival photo directly depicts golden/yellow horizontal lap siding, white trim, two upper windows with navy shutters, glazed entry/sidelight, broad lower multi-panel window, ministry sign and shallow shingle canopy.
The preview reproduces those facade components in the same broad order and uses a procedural lap-siding shader; the model has visible gutters/downspouts, entrance framing and porch supports.
The archive image is a close crop, so side/rear openings and exact dimensions are not source-verified. The model’s sign is simplified to separate text/plaque geometry.
criteria.reason: The distinctive visible frontage is represented well. Small deductions cover unsourced elevations/opening layout and the simplified sign treatment.

evidence: Fresh Blender 5.2.3 open of SHA 7af28c9b8afe5f84a21506b5de2661d9c08e5f8079dee29364ff91ac6e26d6ec found the expected scene and collection, 168 collection objects and 165 mesh objects.
